messages:
tara: Heads-up — Northpoint SI pilot signed. Need a short co-sell intake + marketplace & joint announcement gating plan. Who takes initial pipeline intake?
kevin: I can own intake for quota accounts. @dinesh can you take technical mapping + pre-sale enablement? :+1:
dinesh: Yep. Quick ops rule proposal: any lead with `partner_source=northpoint` in SFDC -> route to KEVIN queue within 24h. Also need a 3-business-day claim window.
kevin: Agree on 24h routing. Timebox: SI has 3 business days to claim/attach a primary contact; otherwise auto-assign to AE.
sam: Marketplace note — we need SKU, short product blurb, co-branding logo assets, and PR cadence. I'll drop the listing template here: https://confluence.redwood.ai/marketplace/templates
jen: One policy question: overlapping accounts where both SI and field want ownership. Proposal: ARR threshold split — >$200k field-led unless field opts in; <=$200k SI-led by default. Thoughts?
tara: That threshold sounds fair. Add: when both claim, mark opportunity `co_sell=true` and create a joint account plan doc.
dinesh: Ops mapping snippet for the automation team:```
partner_tag: northpoint
claim_window_days: 3
auto_assign_to: AE_queue
split_threshold_usd: 200000
```
kevin: Also need escalation: if SI misses claim window, auto-notify partner-ops@redwood.com, cc AE + SE. Escalation SLA: 48h to respond.
partner-bot: New doc created: https://confluence.redwood.ai/partnerships/northpoint-intake (created by tara) :calendar:
jen: Pilot logistics — can we require a weekly 30m sync + one joint demo per week for first 6 weeks? Keeps momentum.
tara: Yes. Add pilot checklist items: embargo date, PR contact, logo usage, customer quote permissions. We'll gate announcement on completed checklist.
dinesh: I'll draft the joint announcement checklist and the SFDC field mapping by EOD Thursday and post back.
kevin: Once dinesh posts mapping I'll update SFDC automation rules and create the queue. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
